'''Kalandis Seven's spaceport''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]].

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]] the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Resurgent Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the Imperials [[Battle of Corellia|withdrew]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] of [[Republic trooper]]s led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]], and [[Advisor/Legends|advised]] by [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] were tasked with the destruction of this spaceport. During their mission a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Command ship/Legends|Planetary command ship]] landed to refuel. Malcom revised their mission to include capturing the command ship. However Malcom was not successful in the capture of the command ship, but the troopers under Immel were successful at destroying the spaceport.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The spaceport was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' released on [[October 2]], [[2012]]. The spaceport first appeared within the pages of [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" which was released on [[October 23]] inside [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]].
